claim.claim-text: 1. A method of manufacturing a battery, the method comprising the steps of:
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the separator comprises boehmite.
3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, further comprising the step of prelithiating the anode with lithium from the lithium metal layer.
4. The method of claim 3, wherein prelithiation of the anode occurs when the battery is charged and discharged in a first charge-discharge cycle.
5. The method of any one of claims 1-4, wherein the method comprises coating the lithium metal layer onto the separator.
6. The method of any one of claims 1-4, wherein the method comprises depositing the lithium metal layer onto the separator by vacuum deposition.
7. The method of any one of claims 1-6, wherein the battery is a lithium ion battery.
8. The method of any one of claims 1-7, wherein the separator is a free-standing separator.
9. The method of any one of claims 1-8, wherein the one or more transition metal oxides are selected from the group consisting of manganese, nickel, and cobalt.
10. The method of any one of claims 1-9, wherein the anode comprises lithium metal
11. The method of any one of claims 1-10, wherein the separator further comprises a second anionic group.
12. The method of any one of claims 1-11, wherein the anode comprises silicon.
13. The method of any one of claims 1-12, wherein the separator has an average pore size of less than 100 nm in diameter.
14. The method of claim 13, wherein the separator has an average pore size of less than 50 nm in diameter.
15. The method of any one of claims 1-14, wherein the anionic compound comprises greater than 0.1 weight % of the weight of the porous separator.
